items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11i · Fuzz Engine v2 + wallet/settlement fixes
items.summary: Major fuzz upgrade: seed corpus and bit-flip mutation (not raw counters), coverage buckets v2 from real 64-bit inputs, SHA256(input) artifacts with check(0x…) repro, diff coverage_delta vs baseline campaigns, fuzz_report_v2. Desktop wallet uses canonical balance without admin header on loopback; VPS settlement timer fixed (/dev/null + admin wallet lookup). New CLI: hackme-fuzzing campaign create|status.
items.impact: B2B integrators get stronger property-fuzz reports; miners get rc11i binaries with fair pool + order escrow unchanged.
items.action: Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · BC5 report: https://hackme.tech/reports/bitcoin-core-5module.html· Gate: bash scripts/ops/fuzz_engine_v2_gate.sh

items.title: Order pool live · 5 HMC test completed (rc11h)
items.summary: Production useful-PoW order order-live-5hmc-202605251816: prepaid 5 HMC (5×1 HMC reward), minimal WASM gate, completed 5/5 in ~2 minutes. Escrow fee 0.25 HMC, burn 0.5 HMC. All five order blocks credited miner_address HMC-381c0c5e2cfcc714 on the canonical node. Pool workers (rc11h) receive order WASM in claim and relay solves to POST /api/poh/solve-order so escrow follows the hybrid signer, not only the operator wallet.
items.impact: Miners on rc11h ISO/Windows/Linux can earn order escrow when their hybrid address wins the chain block; operators see verified prepaid/burn/fee on live mainnet.
